info.title: CoworkingView
info.description: Read public CoworkingView catalogue and price index data for coworking spaces and private offices. Search listings, open a space, operator, or place profile, and read aggregated city prices. No sign-in is required.

get.description: Returns remote configuration for official clients, including feature flags and the minimum supported build. Catalogue reads do not depend on this operation. No sign-in is required.

get.description: Returns one page of listing cards. No sign-in is required. Catalogue content belongs to the listed operators, and systematic copying of the catalogue is not permitted.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Response language. Allowed values are en, de, and es.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. The first page is 1 and the highest page is 500.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items on the page. The value is from 1 to 50.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed for sortBy=random. Required to paginate a random list: reuse the seed returned in meta.seed on every following page, or results repeat and skip.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country slug. Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, from 1 to 200 characters.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City slug. Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, from 1 to 200 characters.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Zone slug within a city. Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, from 1 to 200 characters.

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Operator slug. Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, from 1 to 200 characters.

parameters.name: pricingOptionType
parameters.description: Pricing option used as a filter. Allowed values are private_office, exclusive_bereich, fix_desk, flex_desk, day_pass, meeting_room, virtual_office, event_space, and membership.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated amenity slugs, e.g. wifi,coffee,parking (max 20).

parameters.name: minCapacity
parameters.description: Minimum capacity the listing must offer. The value must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Minimum price in the selected currency. The value is 0 or greater.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Maximum price in the selected currency. The value is 0 or greater.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for prices. Allowed values are EUR, GBP, USD, CHF, VES, and AED.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Result order. A legacy rating order is deprecated: it is still accepted and ordered as the default (random). It is not a member of this enum.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude in WGS84 degrees, from -90 to 90.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude in WGS84 degrees, from -180 to 180.

parameters.name: radiusMeters
parameters.description: Search radius in meters around the given latitude and longitude. The value must be greater than 0 and at most 200000.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Viewport as "west,south,east,north" in WGS84 degrees, e.g. 13.2,52.4,13.6,52.6.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Street address, e.g. "Domstraße 17" or "Calle Velázquez 34". Narrows to listings AT that address (house number inside the listing's number or range) and on the same street; the ones at the address come first, each group in sortBy order. Not geocoded: to search AROUND an address, pass lat/lng + radiusMeters.
